title: Prove q² coupled optima for two resonant Jordan blocks (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Prove the exact optimal-second-callee count for the unchanged ordinary wrapper when `P=diag(J_2(lambda_1),J_2(lambda_2))` and both eigenvalues satisfy `lambda_i^2=1`, over every finite field.

```text
one resonant J2 block:       1 optimum       [credited #5556]
two coupled resonant blocks: q^2 optima      [odd characteristic, new]
                            1 optimum       [characteristic two]
```

Claim type: scoped written proof with exact finite corroboration. The complete parameterization is `Q=P+U D S V`, `S^2=0`, with `U=[e0 e2]`, `V=[e1^T;e3^T]` and `D=diag(2lambda_1,2lambda_2)`. All odd-characteristic optima have determinant one; exactly `q^2-1` have rank-one perturbations. The optimum error rank is two, giving agreement on `q^6` of `q^8` inputs. This does not claim exact interchange in odd characteristic, a native cost advantage or new kappa.

Only six files in `research/coupled-resonant-jordan-pair/` are added. The several-block question and fixed-wrapper reduction come from Nicholas Stone's [#5556](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5556). Nick Petalas's [#5228](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5228) supplies the general equality characterization, and [#6406](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6406) treats the different regular J3 first map. Jerry Chen / CubeJerry's [#2950](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2950) supplies the wrapper optimum and attainer. Predecessor results are cited, not re-audited. Classical block elimination and finite-field counting retain their usual attribution. This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. Apache-2.0.

## Evidence

Before, each resonant block was individually rigid and the several-block count was open. After, the proof forces every optimal perturbation into its image/kernel support and reduces equality to a two-dimensional square-zero parameter. Its determinant filter accepts every parameter, even with mixed signs.

Local CPython 3.12.15 warning-strict normal and optimized verification passes, with identical generated package-hash receipts. The finite checks enumerate 27 field/sign contexts over orders 2,3,4,5,7,8,9,11,13; all 215,848 supported perturbations; all 1,819 accepted wrappers; and every binary four-by-four second map, including 20,160 invertible maps and exactly one optimum. Literal six-operation execution checks 175,832 original input basis columns. Fifteen rejection controls and one coupled positive control pass. Extension fields use exact polynomial coordinates.

Each registered command was timed locally, at 5.39 and 5.46 seconds. The complete registered launcher passed in 11.17 seconds. These are verification durations, not performance-improvement claims. AST compilation, whitespace, metadata/source pins, committed bytes, source-history ancestry and executable modes pass. No registered check is deferred to CI alone.

From the repository root, standard library only:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/coupled-resonant-jordan-pair/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/coupled-resonant-jordan-pair/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/coupled-resonant-jordan-pair
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/coupled-resonant-jordan-pair --check-source-history --check-modes
```

Expected markers are `PASS_COUPLED_RESONANT_JORDAN_PAIR`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. Another CPython 3.12 path may replace the prefix. Direct verification writes no files and imports no predecessor executable. `SOURCES.json` pins predecessor prose and source context as historical provenance.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The formal-interface-lemma card is explicitly changed to an algebraic counting problem. This proves no selected assumption, larger block family, native implementation, physical cost advantage or complete multiplication theorem. Restoration, movement, precision, stock, compiler and complete supplier/outer costs remain unpriced. No predecessor scientific suite, selected cold replay, Lean or Docker run was performed. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. The selected #7000 frontier and frozen predecessors are unchanged.

## Open next questions

- Count a pair with at least one eigenvalue squared different from one. Start with distinct regular eigenvalues over F5 and derive its quotient and determinant filter. The present singular-support reduction does not classify it.
- Price an explicit coupled map in a physically specified ordinary caller, including the actual correctness domain and restoration costs. Optimal agreement alone gives no implementation saving.

## Related open work

No open PR studying this coupled resonant-pair count or optimal-second-callee quantity was found in the refreshed title/body and targeted Jordan searches. At the publication refresh, five other account PRs created after the advance claim concern cyclotomic precision, three-shear COPY floors, address-twist residues, rounded inverse injectivity and polynomial gap insertions. They compute different quantities. No additional computation or numerical agreement/disagreement is claimed. The relevant #5556, #5228 and #6406 are merged predecessors.
